# 07 — Paper Draft Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** The submission-ready manuscript for MDPI Technologies (deadline 30 Aug 2026), written from the results CSVs, with every figure generated by a committed script.

**Architecture:** LaTeX in `journal/paper/` using the MDPI class (download `mdpi.cls` bundle from mdpi.com/authors/latex). Figures in `journal/figures/` as scripts + PNG/PDF pairs. Writing starts when plans 01–03 have results (05 folds in when done; 04/06 get sections only if they land).

## Global Constraints (Phil's writing rules — non-negotiable)

- Full details of methods, including equations.
- Median / max / 95th percentile; 2–3 decimals; never mean/std as headline stats.
- Figures generated from results CSVs, never hand-made.
- **Correction wording: MINIMAL** (decided by Hamza, Aug 2026): one short, matter-of-fact paragraph in Methods — the conference version computed ΔE00 on normalized XYZ, understating errors ~5×; all results here are corrected and supersede it. No dedicated pitfall section unless Phil asks for one on review.
- Benchmarks to cite (Phil, Apr 2026): Kiran's Optics Express n-colour paper; the PhD work at the Scholar profile Phil linked (resolve exact citations during Task 1).
